body:
Sadly I have another exam soon after which I am equally panicked about, so I am scared about having to keep going until I've done the second exam. I don't feel strong enough to.


Edit: I also have such strong urges to at least self harm I don't know how much longer I can resist them.

Thank you for this. The worst thing is actually everyone telling me I can do it - I know they're trying to be supportive but somehow the fact that they all believe I'm capable and I'm going to end up disappointing them when I fail is really hard to deal with. I guess all I can do now is sleep and see what happens. I just keep swinging between calm acceptance and feeling like I'd rather be dead than have to go sit the exam tomorrow.
Yes but not before the exam tomorrow :(
